thread:
Maya (VP Eng): Quick thread to capture the runtime Q&A follow-ups so PMs and infra have a single place to check.
Ravi (Lead Runtime): Kernel cadence recap: weekly incremental canaries, monthly broader rollouts. First canary for kernel-omega next Wednesday, initial traffic 1%, 45m observation window.
Sam (Staff SWE, Runtime): Batching defaults: we'll increase dynamic_batch_token_limit from 8->14 for most gen models. Adding model config flags: `max_batch_tokens` and `batch_timeout_ms`.
Priya (ML Eng): How will this affect long-context cold requests? Need an isolation plan.
Ravi (Lead Runtime): We'll route cold long-context requests to a low-batch lane (max_batch_tokens=3) and prioritize cache-hit traffic for high-batch lanes. Default cache TTLs: short-prefix=10m, session=45m.
Jana (SRE): Observability: add kernel_tag, batch_size_dist, cache_hit_rate to per-route dashboards. Alert if p95 > SLA for 3 consecutive 1m buckets.
Zoe (Product): Customers want a short quantization guidance doc. Can we provide quick tradeoffs?
Maya (VP Eng): Action: Priya + Sam to draft a one-pager "quantization playbook" with measured p50/p95 and example prompts. Due EOD Friday.
Ravi (Lead Runtime): Canary rollback criteria proposal: auto-rollback on p95 delta >6% vs baseline OR error-rate +3% OR any new OOM. Smoke suite (100 short + 30 long prompts) runs before expansion.
ops-bot: Canary created: id=canary-216789, start=2026-05-05T17:00:00Z, initial_traffic=1%.
Sam (Staff SWE, Runtime): I'll add kernel_variant and batching_profile to traces/logs for debugging (not surfaced in API responses).
Maya (VP Eng): Summary/action owners: (1) Priya+Sam: quantization one-pager (EOD Fri), (2) Ravi: batching config PR + default table (next week), (3) Jana: alert/runbook PR (Mon), (4) Console: canary banner (small UI note). I'll follow up with calendar invites.
Ravi (Lead Runtime): I'll post the batching PR link here when ready.
Priya (ML Eng): Starting perf runs now; will attach small p50/p95 table once done.
Maya (VP Eng): Thanks all — keep updates here and we'll reopen if anything blocks. :white_check_mark:
